cond_0001.intro:
The Measurement Technology (MTech) Analyst position is responsible for ensuring the meter assets of the organization are supported by monitoring the day-to-day deployment and health of meters in the field and inventory. This includes analyzing metering issues and identifying improvements to business processes. As a subject matter expert, this position formulates requirements, based on department needs, and confers with supervision and other MTech Analysts to discern applicable business processes and industry requirements.
This position will oversee the set-up of electric meters in various metering and customer systems to assure that metering parameters are assigned correctly. The MTech Analyst will have oversight over the [Product name masked] AMI, Meter Data Operations (MDM) and Operational Device Management (ODM) systems serving as the first line troubleshooter for the systems and network equipment. This position also supports the [Product name masked] system with regard to the hardware, software, translation, reporting and maintenance of the system. The applicant must be able to correlate metering data with billing data to ensure the health of the overall AMI system and analyze bill cycle performance. The successful candidate will also contribute through technical and analytical support; PC network, hardware, and software support for field personnel; budgeting analysis and scorecard reporting.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Maintains meter setup accuracy in metering systems. Identifies and recommends/proposes new processes to increase efficiency and productivity, and improve functionality, reliability and quality. Follows policies and procedures to ensure corporate data security and change control. Serves as primary contact for assigned business function/unit for all daily production problems. Verifies, updates or adds multiplier and measuring component attributes in metering systems. Coordinates tasks and issue resolutions with vendors and internal personnel in IT, Billing, Metering and Load Research departments. Serves as an internal customer advocate by responding to inquiries from Billing, Load Research and other departments.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Advanced Degree or approved certification and 1 year of business analyst experience, OR Bachelor's Degree and 2 years of business analyst experience, OR 8 years of business analyst experience, OR 5 years of relevant experience in ODM/MDM, CCB/CIS, [Product name masked] and [Product name masked] systems.
Understands meter characteristics and the effects they have on customer billing accuracy.
Ensures meter setup accuracy within ODM, MDM, CCB, [Product name masked], [Product name masked], and AMI systems.
Understands and recognizes when business practices can be improved through technology.
Effective written and oral communication skills.
Uses planning skills to coordinate and complete projects on time and on budget.

Strong interpersonal skills to resolve problems in a professional manner, lead working groups, negotiate and create consensus.
Assists internal and external customers with metering data as needed.
Maintains a high level of professionalism at all times.

Bachelor's degree in business, information technology or a related field.
Experience working with various computer systems and database applications, as well as a strong technical background in maintenance and reliability applications.

The Measurement Technology (MTech) Analyst position is responsible for ensuring the meter assets of the organization are supported by monitoring the deployment and health of meters in the field and inventory. This includes analyzing metering issues and identifying improvements to business processes. As a subject matter expert, this position formulates requirements based on department needs, and coordinates with supervision and other MTech Analysts to determine applicable business processes and industry requirements.
This position oversees the set-up of electric meters in various metering and customer systems to confirm that metering parameters are assigned correctly. The MTech Analyst will have oversight over the [Product name masked] AMI, Meter Data Operations (MDM) and Operational Device Management (ODM) systems, serving as the first-line troubleshooter for the systems and network equipment. This position also supports the [Product name masked] system with regard to hardware, software, translation, reporting and maintenance. The applicant must be able to correlate metering data with billing data to confirm the health of the overall AMI system and analyze bill cycle performance. The successful candidate will also contribute through technical and analytical support; PC network, hardware, and software support for field personnel; budgeting analysis and scorecard reporting.
cond_0016.responsibilities:
Maintains meter setup accuracy in metering systems.
Identifies and proposes new processes to increase efficiency and productivity, and improve functionality, reliability and quality.
Follows policies and procedures to ensure corporate data security and change control.
Serves as primary contact for assigned business function/unit for daily production problems.
Verifies, updates or adds multiplier and measuring component attributes in metering systems.
Coordinates task completion and issue resolution with vendors and internal personnel in IT, Billing, Metering and Load Research departments.
Responds to inquiries from Billing, Load Research and other departments regarding metering data.
cond_0016.requirements:
The preferred candidate will possess a Bachelor's degree in business, information technology or a related field. They will also have experience working with various computer systems and database applications as well as a strong technical background in maintenance and reliability applications. Prior experience in the utility industry and/or technical related field around reliability and maintenance is preferred. Typically has one of the following:
Advanced Degree or approved certification and 1-year business analyst experience.
OR
Bachelor's Degree and 2 years business analyst experience.
OR
8 Years of business analyst experience.
OR
5 Years of relevant experience in ODM/MDM, CCB/CIS, [Product name masked] and [Product name masked] systems.
Understands meter characteristics and the effects they have on customer billing accuracy.
Expertise in standard concepts, best practices and company procedures related to at least two [Company name masked] business functions.
Working knowledge of [Company name masked] technology applications used in assigned business functions.
Increasing familiarity with the complexity and inter-relatedness of business functions and company technology applications.
Understands and recognizes when business practices can be improved through technology.
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting skills.
Ensures meter setup accuracy within ODM, MDM, CCB, [Product name masked], [Product name masked], and AMI systems.
Uses planning skills to coordinate and complete projects on time and on budget.
Exercises sound judgment when making decisions.
Maintains a high level of professionalism at all times.
Good organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks within defined time constraints.
Interpersonal skills sufficient to resolve problems professionally, contribute to working groups, and reach agreement with relevant parties.
Assists internal and external customers with metering data as needed.

This position will oversee the set-up of electric meters in various metering and customer systems to assure that metering parameters are assigned correctly. The Measurement Technology (MTech) Analyst is responsible for ensuring the meter assets of the organization are supported by monitoring the day-to-day deployment and health of meters in the field and inventory. This includes regularly analyzing metering issues and identifying improvements to business processes. As a subject matter expert, this position formulates requirements based on department needs, and actively confers with supervision and other MTech Analysts to clarify applicable business processes and industry requirements.
This position oversees the set-up of electric meters in various metering and customer systems to assure that metering parameters are assigned correctly. The MTech Analyst has oversight over the [Product name masked] AMI, Meter Data Operations (MDM) and Operational Device Management (ODM) systems, serving as the first-line troubleshooter for the systems and network equipment. This position also supports the [Product name masked] system with regard to hardware, software, translation, reporting and maintenance. The candidate must be able to correlate metering data with billing data to ensure the health of the overall AMI system and analyze bill cycle performance. The role also involves regular technical and analytical support; PC network, hardware, and software support for field personnel; budgeting analysis and scorecard reporting.

Verifies, updates or adds multiplier and measuring component attributes in metering systems.

Serves as an internal customer advocate by actively responding to inquiries from Billing, Load Research and other departments.

cond_0113.intro:
The Measurement Technology (MTech) Analyst position is responsible for ensuring the meter assets of the organization are supported by monitoring the day-to-day deployment and health of meters in the field and inventory. This includes analyzing metering issues and identifying improvements to business processes. As a subject matter expert, this position formulates requirements, based on department needs, and confers with supervision and other MTech Analysts to discern applicable business processes and industry requirements.
This position will oversee the set-up of electric meters in various metering and customer systems to assure that metering parameters are assigned correctly. The MTech Analyst will have oversight over the [Product name masked] AMI, Meter Data Operations (MDM) and Operational Device Management (ODM) systems serving as the first line troubleshooter for the systems and network equipment. This position also supports the [Product name masked] system with regard to the hardware, software, translation, reporting and maintenance of the system. The applicant must be able to correlate metering data with billing data to ensure the health of the overall AMI system and analyze bill cycle performance. The successful candidate will also contribute through technical and analytical support; PC network, hardware, and software support for field personnel; budgeting analysis and scorecard reporting. Most people become stronger in this kind of metering and systems analysis work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.

cond_0153.intro:
The Measurement Technology (MTech) Analyst works alongside the department to help ensure meter assets are well-supported through shared monitoring of day-to-day deployment and field health of meters. This includes working with others to analyze metering issues and identify improvements to business processes. As a subject matter expert, this position helps formulate requirements based on department needs, and coordinates with supervision and other MTech Analysts to clarify applicable business processes and industry requirements.
This position supports the set-up of electric meters in various metering and customer systems to help ensure metering parameters are assigned correctly. The MTech Analyst will work closely with teams supporting [Product name masked] AMI, Meter Data Operations (MDM) and Operational Device Management (ODM) systems, serving as a first-line troubleshooter for systems and network equipment. This position also supports the [Product name masked] system with regard to hardware, software, translation, reporting and maintenance. The analyst will work with billing and operations teams to correlate metering data with billing data and help ensure the health of the overall AMI system and bill cycle performance. The role also contributes through shared technical and analytical support, PC network and hardware/software support for field personnel, and collaborative budgeting analysis and scorecard reporting.
cond_0153.responsibilities:
Maintains meter setup accuracy in metering systems.
Works with the team to identify and recommend new processes that increase efficiency, productivity, and improve functionality, reliability, and quality.
Follows policies and procedures to help ensure corporate data security and change control.
Serves as primary contact for assigned business function/unit for daily production problems, coordinating resolutions with relevant teams.
Verifies, updates, or adds multiplier and measuring component attributes in metering systems.
Coordinates tasks and issue resolutions with vendors and internal personnel in IT, Billing, Metering, and Load Research departments.
Supports internal customers by responding to inquiries from Billing, Load Research, and other departments.
cond_0153.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Advanced Degree or approved certification and 1 year of business analyst experience, OR Bachelor's Degree and 2 years of business analyst experience, OR 8 years of business analyst experience, OR 5 years of relevant experience in ODM/MDM, CCB/CIS, [Product name masked] and [Product name masked] systems.
Understands meter characteristics and the effects they have on customer billing accuracy.
Ensures meter setup accuracy within ODM, MDM, CCB, [Product name masked], [Product name masked], and AMI systems.
Effective written and oral communication skills.
Good organizational skills and the ability to multi-task and work under pressure and time constraints.
Exercises sound judgment when making decisions.
Maintains a high level of professionalism at all times.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in business, information technology, or a related field.
Experience working with various computer systems and database applications, with a strong technical background in maintenance and reliability applications.
Prior experience in the utility industry and/or a technical field related to reliability and maintenance.
Expertise in standard concepts, best practices, and company procedures related to at least two [Company name masked] business functions.
Working knowledge of [Company name masked] technology applications used in assigned business functions.
Familiarity with the complexity and inter-relatedness of business functions and company technology applications.
Understands and recognizes when business practices can be improved through technology.

The Measurement Technology (MTech) Analyst is responsible for ensuring the meter assets of the organization are supported by monitoring the day-to-day deployment and health of meters in the field and inventory. This includes regularly analyzing metering issues and identifying improvements to business processes. As a subject matter expert, this position formulates requirements based on department needs, and actively confers with supervision and other MTech Analysts to clarify applicable business processes and industry requirements.
This position oversees the set-up of electric meters in various metering and customer systems to assure that metering parameters are assigned correctly. The MTech Analyst has oversight over the [Product name masked] AMI, Meter Data Operations (MDM) and Operational Device Management (ODM) systems, serving as the first-line troubleshooter for the systems and network equipment. This position also supports the [Product name masked] system with regard to hardware, software, translation, reporting and maintenance. The candidate must be able to correlate metering data with billing data to ensure the health of the overall AMI system and analyze bill cycle performance. The role also involves regular technical and analytical support; PC network, hardware, and software support for field personnel; budgeting analysis and scorecard reporting.
cond_0222.responsibilities:
Maintains meter setup accuracy in metering systems.
Identifies and recommends new processes to increase efficiency and productivity, and improve functionality, reliability and quality.
Follows policies and procedures to ensure corporate data security and change control.
Serves as primary contact for assigned business function/unit for all daily production problems, staying in close contact with stakeholders to resolve issues quickly.
Verifies, updates or adds multiplier and measuring component attributes in metering systems.
Coordinates tasks and issue resolutions daily with vendors and internal personnel in IT, Billing, Metering and Load Research departments.
Serves as an internal customer advocate by actively responding to inquiries from Billing, Load Research and other departments.
cond_0222.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Understands meter characteristics and the effects they have on customer billing accuracy.
Ensures meter setup accuracy within ODM, MDM, CCB, [Product name masked], [Product name masked], and AMI systems.
Effective written and oral communication skills, including the ability to explain trade-offs and walk colleagues through decisions.
Strong interpersonal skills to resolve problems in a professional manner, lead working groups, negotiate and create consensus.
Understands and recognizes when business practices can be improved through technology.
Good organizational skills and the ability to multi-task and work under pressure and time constraints.
Uses planning skills to coordinate and complete projects on time and on budget.
Exercises sound judgment when making decisions.
Maintains a high level of professionalism at all times.
Assists internal and external customers with metering data as needed.
One of the following experience levels:
Advanced degree or approved certification and 1 year of business analyst experience
Bachelor's degree and 2 years of business analyst experience
8 Years of business analyst experience
5 Years of relevant experience in ODM/MDM, CCB/CIS, [Product name masked] and [Product name masked] systems
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in business, information technology or a related field.
Experience working with various computer systems and database applications.
Strong technical background in maintenance and reliability applications.
Prior experience in the utility industry and/or a technical field related to reliability and maintenance.
Expertise in standard concepts, best practices and company procedures related to at least two [Company name masked] business functions.
Working knowledge of [Company name masked] technology applications used in assigned business functions.
Increasing familiarity with the complexity and inter-relatedness of business functions and company technology applications.

This includes analyzing metering issues and identifying improvements to business processes. This position will oversee the set-up of electric meters in various metering and customer systems to assure that metering parameters are assigned correctly. cond_0451.intro:
The Measurement Technology (MTech) Analyst position is responsible for ensuring the meter assets of the organization are supported by monitoring the day-to-day deployment and health of meters in the field and inventory. This includes analyzing metering issues and identifying improvements to business processes. As a subject matter expert, this position formulates requirements, based on department needs, and confers with supervision and other MTech Analysts to discern applicable business processes and industry requirements.
This position will oversee the set-up of electric meters in various metering and customer systems to assure that metering parameters are assigned correctly. The MTech Analyst will have oversight over the [Product name masked] AMI, Meter Data Operations (MDM) and Operational Device Management (ODM) systems serving as the first line troubleshooter for the systems and network equipment. This position also supports the [Product name masked] system with regard to the hardware, software, translation, reporting and maintenance of the system. The applicant must be able to correlate metering data with billing data to ensure the health of the overall AMI system and analyze bill cycle performance. The successful candidate will also contribute through technical and analytical support; PC network, hardware, and software support for field personnel; budgeting analysis and scorecard reporting.
cond_0451.responsibilities: Maintains meter setup accuracy in metering systems. Identifies and recommends/proposes new processes to increase efficiency and productivity, and improve functionality, reliability and quality. Follows policies and procedures to ensure corporate data security and change control. Serves as primary contact for assigned business function/unit for all daily production problems. Verifies, updates or adds multiplier and measuring component attributes in metering systems. Coordinates tasks and issue resolutions with vendors and internal personnel in IT, Billing, Metering and Load Research departments. Serves as an internal customer advocate by responding to inquiries from Billing, Load Research and other departments.
cond_0451.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Advanced Degree or approved certification and 1 year of business analyst experience, OR Bachelor's Degree and 2 years of business analyst experience, OR 8 years of business analyst experience, OR 5 years of relevant experience in ODM/MDM, CCB/CIS, [Product name masked] and [Product name masked] systems.
Understands meter characteristics and the effects they have on customer billing accuracy.
Ensures meter setup accuracy within ODM, MDM, CCB, [Product name masked], [Product name masked], and AMI systems.
Understands and recognizes when business practices can be improved through technology.
Effective written and oral communication skills.
Uses planning skills to coordinate and complete projects on time and on budget.
Exercises sound judgment when making decisions.
Good organizational skills and the ability to multi-task and work under pressure and time constraints.
Strong interpersonal skills to resolve problems in a professional manner, lead working groups, negotiate and create consensus.
Assists internal and external customers with metering data as needed.
Maintains a high level of professionalism at all times.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in business, information technology or a related field.
Experience working with various computer systems and database applications, as well as a strong technical background in maintenance and reliability applications.
Prior experience in the utility industry and/or technical related field around reliability and maintenance.
Expertise in standard concepts, best practices and company procedures related to at least two [Company name masked] business functions.
Working knowledge about [Company name masked] technology applications used in assigned business functions.

cond_0475.intro:
The Measurement Technology (MTech) Analyst is responsible for ensuring meter assets are supported by monitoring the deployment and health of meters in the field and inventory. This includes analyzing metering issues and identifying improvements to business processes. As a subject matter expert, this position formulates requirements based on department needs, and coordinates with supervision and other MTech Analysts to clarify applicable business processes and industry requirements.
This position oversees the set-up of electric meters in various metering and customer systems to confirm that metering parameters are assigned correctly. The MTech Analyst will have oversight over the [Product name masked] AMI, Meter Data Operations (MDM) and Operational Device Management (ODM) systems, serving as the first-line troubleshooter for the systems and network equipment. This position also supports the [Product name masked] system with regard to hardware, software, translation, reporting and maintenance. The applicant must be able to correlate metering data with billing data to confirm the health of the overall AMI system and analyze bill cycle performance. The role also involves technical and analytical support, PC network and hardware/software support for field personnel, budgeting analysis, and scorecard reporting.

Verifies, updates, or adds multiplier and measuring component attributes in metering systems.
